facts.fact: The Guardian Nigeria reports that the Advertising Regulatory Council of Nigeria (ARCON) launched an investigation into fake adverts using AI-simulated voice and image of public figures on Facebook and Instagram, set up a special enforcement unit to monitor them in real time, and said it would explore legal action against Meta and others.
facts.system: ARCON investigation into AI-generated fake adverts

NGA.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No AI tool in a public sector's system is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
